verdict.rationale: Jan's README says it downloads and runs LLMs such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and GPT-oss from Hugging Face. Its docs describe entering a Hugging Face model ID in the Hub search bar, and the changelog adds pause/resume for model downloads. Execution runs locally via llama.cpp, and GGUF files can also be imported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Hugging Face download-and-run workflow.
